items.title: Albert Jiles Interview, 1961-02-24
items.q: [INTERVIEWEE] Old Gaspar was the bass player, bass violin player, not a tuba player, bass violin player.

ctx.x: The regular band he played in, the longest and played until he died, was the Excelsa Brass Band. That was one of the leading brass bands of the city.
Well, who had that band? Well, Gaspar.
I think Boccage, Contrell, he was a drummer, snare drummer. The Old Man Contrell.
